scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:00 - 00:00:02:19
The simplest one
track can refresh frequency
00:00:02:19 - 00:00:05:19
by running the scraper weekly
and comparing data sets.
00:00:05:19 - 00:00:09:00
You can see how often competitors swap out
creatives
00:00:09:04 - 00:00:12:01
or simply how many ads they choose to run.
00:00:12:01 - 00:00:14:17
Brands
that refresh frequently are likely testing
00:00:14:17 - 00:00:17:17
aggressively, which means they haven't
found a winner yet.
00:00:17:21 - 00:00:20:15
They also heavily
adapt their ads to the platform.
00:00:20:15 - 00:00:24:22
What works for Facebook will not always
pan out for Instagram in any case.
00:00:25:01 - 00:00:29:06
Brands with long running ads probably have
something that's working worth studying.
00:00:30:07 - 00:00:33:02
Another big one creative format analysis.
00:00:33:02 - 00:00:36:03
Sort ads by media type
and look at the ratio of video
00:00:36:03 - 00:00:39:01
to image to carousel
across your competitors.
00:00:39:01 - 00:00:42:03
If three out of four competitors
have shifted heavily toward video
00:00:42:03 - 00:00:46:11
in the last month, that's a signal worth
paying attention to from there.
00:00:46:17 - 00:00:48:08
Compare regional messaging.
00:00:48:08 - 00:00:51:24
Filter your data sets by country
and look at how the same brand adjust
00:00:51:24 - 00:00:52:15
its copy.
00:00:52:15 - 00:00:55:10
CTAs and offers for different markets.
00:00:55:10 - 00:00:58:08
You might find that a competitor leads
with price in Brazil,
00:00:58:08 - 00:01:00:02
but with ingredients in Germany.
00:01:00:02 - 00:01:03:22
Those are positioning insights
that directly inform your own localization
00:01:03:22 - 00:01:05:15
strategy.
00:01:05:15 - 00:01:09:03
One more powerful use case
you're one step away from price scraping
00:01:09:18 - 00:01:12:18
Facebook AD library
scraper gives you the CTA links.
00:01:12:23 - 00:01:16:20
Follow them and you on the product page
with all the details and pricing.
00:01:17:05 - 00:01:20:18
Combine that with epiphytes
e-commerce scraping tool and suddenly
00:01:20:18 - 00:01:22:04
you're not just tracking ads.
00:01:22:04 - 00:01:25:04
You're building a full e-commerce
intelligence engine.
00:01:25:10 - 00:01:27:22
And finally, use the page transparency
00:01:27:22 - 00:01:30:22
data for compliance
or competitive intelligence.
00:01:31:05 - 00:01:35:04
Admin location distribution tells you
where brands operations are concentrated.
00:01:35:14 - 00:01:39:00
If a competitor claims to be a local brand
but their page admins are spread
00:01:39:00 - 00:01:40:17
across three continents.
00:01:40:17 - 00:01:42:19
That's useful context for positioning.
